decisions.reason: We would keep the coolant pressure booster system because it is core-adjacent, the industry is growing, and there is still no clear sign that its results fall below our internal or peer-based aspiration levels.

We would keep the coolant cleaning centrifuge because it fits our established coolant-management business and no performance shortfall is evident that would trigger problemistic search and withdrawal.

We would keep the coolant nozzles line because its modular variants complement broader system sales and a large firm with slack would not drop it without clear evidence of underperforming aspirations.

We would keep the scraper belt chip conveyor but monitor it more closely because it is somewhat less central to the core portfolio and would be a candidate for reallocation if results disappointed relative to aspirations.
We would keep the magnetic belt chip conveyor because it builds directly on our conveying capabilities and continued market growth reduces pressure to exit absent a visible aspiration-level failure.

We would keep the hinged belt chip conveyor for now, though with a somewhat higher exit risk than core products, because adjacent launches are retained while performance remains uncertain but not clearly below aspiration.
